summary_en: DM Solutions introduced progressive dividend policy whereby annual per-share dividend will not decline year-over-year and will maintain or increase from prior levels. Interim dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 set at ¥10.50 per share, up from ¥7.50 in the prior interim period.
summary_jp: 累進配当を導入し、年間1株当たり配当金を前年度から減額しない方針に転換。2026年9月30日基準の中間配当は1株当たり10円50銭で、前年同期の7円50銭から増加。
